effects.description:
You can transform up to two Treasure Areas into Sew-Sew Treasure Areas.
Enemies' Treasure Capture Speeds are reduced by 50% (stacks up to 80%) while in a Sew-Sew Treasure Area.
Sew-Sew Treasure Areas cannot be captured, and their Treasure Gauges cannot reach 0.
The Sew-Sew Treasure Area is removed after a certain period of time, or when you are KO'd.

skills.detail:
While the skill button is held down, you are able to move.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.
